content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a race condition where the reply handler was updating the congestion window (cwnd) and allowing more RPC calls to be sent before the necessary Receive Work Requests (WRs) were posted to handle incoming replies. This led to a situation where the system could not receive replies, resulting in a Receive Not Ready (RNR) error and the immediate loss of the new connection. The issue was exacerbated when KASAN and disconnect injection were enabled, which slowed down the posting of Receive WRs, allowing the send side to overwhelm the system with RPC calls before the Receive completion handler could respond appropriately.
